target: All consecutive visits of each jar with Euplotes sample count exactly zero at t and valid count at t+1; next visit Euplotes sample >0. No true occupancy inference.
reference: t current zero spell length, day/81, current total positive other patches /14, log1p other patch predator count sum, nearest ring distance to a positive, own current sample volume, treatment assigned small world, time block 2
candidate: reference + exact number of positive neighbors at ring distance 1 and 2, from the same t observation (does not assert migrant movement)
validation: Leave one entire of 14 independent experimental metapopulations out; fit L2 logistic with StandardScaler on training only; deterministic C=1, liblinear; equal fold mean C-R logloss; seeded 2000 descriptive cluster bootstrap
pre_declared_sign: Candidate useful if C−R<0; sign not guaranteed and any loss increase must be reported. No subgroup rescue.
limits: Dataset already published and all labels exposed in v1.222/223
Predict observed count redetection only, not local colonization
Ring geometry not actual realized time-varying source transport
Lagged prey unavailable until original author R dilution code is verified, so this is NOT a rich R3 reference
No causal rescue or ecological independent proof
Repeated rows within 14 metapopulations, independent heldout at metapopulation level
Do not reinterpret positive sign as model inadequacy theorem
